runs.name: IDM v0 demo (full03 unchanged, held-out match -11)
runs.result: Moving-yaw MAE 0.63 vs 2.12 zero-motion; press F1 0.44–0.56; pitch weak; holds not predicted

runs.name: IDM VOD-domain test (full03 on 1080p60 7 Mbps and 720p60 re-encodes of -11/-12)
runs.result: Compression costs only ~3% yaw and 1–3% pitch, so streamer VODs are a viable labelling target

runs.name: IDM v2-a fit (H100, 34 min)
runs.result: Beats full03: moving yaw −17–19%, pitch −22–26%, press F1 up to 0.85, new held-key head

runs.name: IDM v2-b, v2-c, v2-d fits (H100)
runs.cost: ~$22 (app `rivals-idm-v2` $25.54 incl. v2-a and the input volume)
runs.result: The v2-c+v2-d ensemble ("v2-cd") is the best labeller: yaw −22/−23%, pitch −32/−29% vs full03; swing-hold F1 0.88

runs.name: IDM zoom/camera-scale fit (H100, 17 min) plus per-creator check
runs.result: All 8 creators read at James's FOV (0.993–1.000), so camera_scale = 1.0

runs.name: IDM labelling of the expert corpus (v2-a, then v2-cd)
runs.result: v2-a on ~27 h; v2-cd on 24+/40 videos, the rest resumes on the PC at $0

runs.name: Expert footage corpus (Modal CPU screening; PC downloads)
runs.result: 53.3 h of verified Spider-Man gameplay, 9,350 spans, 40 videos, 8 keyboard/mouse creators, from 218 h downloaded

runs.name: Policy v0 packaging (existing NitroGen no-history checkpoint, live API)
runs.result: p95 31 ms; buttons OK (web_swing F1 0.83); yaw at chance (47%)

runs.name: Policy bc2 yaw fit (ego-motion input; H100)
runs.result: Val yaw 0.825 vs zero 1.831; moving sign 89%; onset only 53% under median decode

runs.name: Mean-decode fix plus frame-interval input (bc2-dt)
runs.result: Onset sign 49–54% → 75–77% with no retrain; moving sign 93.5%

runs.name: Architecture grid H (LSTM 1024/1536, 2 layers)
runs.result: 2-layer 1536: val yaw 0.779, onset 79%, F1 0.295

runs.name: Expert-mix scaling grid i3 (own vs +93k vs +399k IDM v2-a expert steps, 3 seeds)
runs.result: Yaw 0.786 → 0.746, onset 79 → 83%, false turns 10.2 → 7.9%, F1 0.314 → 0.363; every mix seed beats every own seed on yaw. The core VPT-style result
runs.decision: Yes; bundle `bc2-mix399-s0` is the live model

runs.name: Grid i4 (469k v2-a expert steps, 3 seeds)
runs.result: Camera plateaued (val yaw 0.755 vs 0.746); only buttons still gained (F1 0.381)
runs.decision: No (confirmed a plateau; could have been 1 seed or local)

runs.name: Grid j (v2-cd vs v2-a labels, same 5 DayMR shards, 3 seeds)
runs.result: No downstream gain from the better labels (val yaw 0.797 vs 0.776)
runs.decision: No (should have been a 1-seed probe first)

runs.name: Motion-input dropout retrain, grid k (p = 0.3 and 0.5, 1 seed each)
runs.result: Criterion (on the retained live frames: hold ≥ 0.3, turn ≥ 0.2; val yaw ≤ 0.766, F1 ≥ 0.33) not met: hold 0.04, turn 0.05. p = 0.3 kept val yaw 0.742 and raised F1 to 0.405

runs.name: RL reward readers (hit, KO, HP, death, fall)
runs.result: Hit P 1.00 / R 0.98 (900 frames); KO 142/142 real; HP 67/67; all 10 non-sealed range takes labelled: James 7.0 KOs/min vs scripted 4.2

runs.name: Offline AWR step 0
runs.result: No measurable held-out shift over 3 seeds (every CI spans 0); BC metrics intact
runs.decision: No (a clean negative; kept only as the online-RL initialiser)

runs.name: World model full-01 (DIAMOND-style, 72×128, 10 Hz)
runs.result: Beats copy-last (+4.3 dB at 0.1 s); actions matter (+3.2 dB vs shuffled); dissolves by ~1 s

runs.name: World model v2-noroll (144×256, 12-frame context)
runs.result: Ties full-01; sampled frames hazy from step 1; imagined KO AUC 0.69

runs.name: World model v2-main (+ own-rollout training)
runs.result: Same as v2-noroll within noise; the anti-drift trick didn't help

runs.name: World model v3-expert (+ 21.7 h IDM-labelled expert data)
runs.result: +0.2 dB at 2–3 s, −0.35 dB early; imagined KO AUC 0.65; 2–3 s target not met
runs.decision: No (pixel track stopped; latent track next, local)

runs.name: World model probes, diagnostics and sampler sweep
runs.result: The 2–3 s error is content, not camera (Spearman 0.13); more denoising steps don't help

runs.name: Learned live runner plus bundle swaps
runs.result: Built and safety-read SAFE; mocked replays p95 45–46 ms on a quiet GPU

runs.result: Stopped: 121 of 126 decisions stale (inference ~95 ms over the 100 ms bound), and the output idled (yaw ≈ 0, no presses). Run B held
